description: Close drawing-only coordinate UI and staircase-calculation debt; retain historical architectural models and transfer physical support verification to the structural-analysis repository.

items.issue: Coordinate/provenance panel occupied 2D plan and moving coordinate duplicated beneath plan
items.resolution: 100 mm coordinate preview/pinned tools moved to east inspector; bottom duplicate hidden with strong [hidden] rule; 2D heading links to east pane.

items.issue: Long static building-grid captions, axis disclaimer and stair-offset sentence crowded plans
items.resolution: Preserve dimension ticks, BX numbers, axis bubbles and datum paths, but show semantic explanation and stair offset in east inspector.

items.issue: Coordinate inspector difficult to find on mobile or inside embedded workspace
items.resolution: Add Coordinates / stair schedule jump from 2D header; keep east inspector at top of its panel in standard editor.

items.issue: Unexplained 18-riser/250-going U-stair proportions across GF, FF and roof access
items.resolution: Derived exact riser, flight, run, landings, bay footprint, roof continuation, datum offset and 11-inch option from v3.3 manifest, with native arithmetic QA and visible read-only stair schedule.

items.issue: Earlier 11-inch tread preference not represented by actual 250 mm stair geometry
items.resolution: 279.4 mm tread is an explicitly non-drawn space option. Do not shift any original wall, room or staircase without further layout verification.

items.issue: B1 marker on X3600 intersects drawn landing envelope and stair datum remains at X4175
items.resolution: Record 575 mm drawing offset and transfer actual support, footprint and column position validation to structural-analysis owner. No change to drawing-only B marker/source wall.

items.issue: Finished headroom and real slab/guard/beam dimensions lack direct measurements
items.resolution: Record unknowns without fabricating clear-height or approved member dimensions. Later verify using real source survey/as-built or peer analysis.

items.issue: Large right FF C4–C2 opening faces right boundary
items.resolution: Architectural opening remains as owner-approved visual candidate; permit, fire and structural lintel checks transferred to appropriate review authority.

governance.releaseGate: CAD Unified Website Staging QA → CAD Main GitHub Pages → independent live readback
